signedOut.title: Sign in to Agent X
signedOut.body: Agent X lets your AI agents pay approved suppliers within limits your team sets. Sign in with your work account and passkey.
signedOut.ended: Your session ended. Sign in again to carry on.
choose.title: Choose an organisation
choose.body: You belong to more than one. You can switch at any time from the top of the page.
choose.unreadable: One of your organisations can't be checked right now. Its admins have been alerted, and nothing in it can change until it's resolved.
none.title: You're not in an organisation yet
none.body: Ask an admin of your organisation to invite you. Once you accept, it appears here.
frozen.banner: This organisation is frozen. No agent can spend until an admin unfreezes it.
soon.approvals: Payments waiting for your approval will appear here.
soon.payments: Every payment and its timeline will appear here.
soon.agents: Your organisation's agents and their keys will appear here.
more.title: More
error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: Agent X couldn't load this page. Try again in a moment.
notFound.title: Page not found
